# Tools and actions

<!-- Generated by tools/docs/api_reference.py from contracts/openapi; do not edit. -->

Base path: `https://<gateway>/tool-gateway`. Every call needs an API key or a Studio session (see [Authentication](index.md#authentication)). Request and response fields are in the OpenAPI document, `contracts/openapi/tool-gateway.json`.

| Method | Path | What it does | Body | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/approvals` | The approvals log (Studio Actions). |  | 200 list of `ApprovalOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/approvals/{approval_id}/decision` | Confirmations are decided by the person who asked; human approvals by authorised staff. | `DecisionIn` | 200 `ApprovalOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/calls` | The call log (no arguments or results. |  | 200 list of `CallOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/credentials` | List Credentials |  | 200 list of object |
| `PUT` | `/v1/credentials/{name}` | Store a credential for this workspace. | `CredentialIn` | 204 |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/credentials/{name}` | Delete Credential |  | 204 |
| `POST` | `/v1/openapi/import` | Turn an OpenAPI 3 document into tool definitions (saved and published through config). | `OpenApiIn` | 200 list of object |
| `GET` | `/v1/tools/{name}` | What a caller (and a model choosing arguments) may know. |  | 200 object |
| `POST` | `/v1/tools/{name}/approvals` | Record exactly what will run, for the caller to confirm (writes always need this). | `ApprovalIn` | 201 `ApprovalOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/tools/{name}/dry-run` | Validate arguments and show the request that would be sent. | `DryRunIn` | 200 object |
| `POST` | `/v1/tools/{name}/invoke` | Invoke | `InvokeIn` | 200 `InvokeOut` |
